collection.title: Lexus IS Series IS 300 2005 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Lexus IS 300 Series 2005 - 2013 model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
